  "summary": "This creates a public S3 bucket configured as a static website in development. The tags say 'public static marketing site' and 'DataClassification: public', which suggests intentional public exposure, but confirmation is needed that this is the correct bucket and environment.",
  "rules": ["R2"],
  "reasons": [
    {
      "claim": "bucket is configured for public website hosting with unrestricted read access",
      "rule": "R2",

      "expected_value": "[{\"suffix\": \"index.html\"}]"
    },
    {
      "claim": "bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to any principal on the internet",
      "rule": "R2",
      "evidence_pointer": "resource_changes[3].change.after.policy",
      "expected_value": "{\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Sid\":\"PublicReadForWebsite\",\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":\"*\",\"Action\":\"s3:GetObject\",\"Resource\":\"arn:aws:s3:::lgnd-marketing-site-dev/*\"}]}"
    }
  ],
  "dismissed": [],
  "confirmations": [
    "the bucket name lgnd-marketing-site-dev is correct for the intended marketing site",
    "development environment is the right place for this public website",
    "only marketing content will be uploaded to this bucket, no sensitive data"
  ]
}
